messages.subject: Helio — completion checklist and next steps
messages.plaintextBody:
Liam,

A quick housekeeping note now we've signed. Outstanding items on our completion checklist are: (1) Brightwater to raise the implementation fee invoice on signature, and (2) the go-live kick-off to be scheduled for 1 May. Everything else (legal approvals, sign-off, executed PDF exchange) is complete. I'll send the closing bundle through shortly.

Elena Marchetti
Whitfield Carter LLP
